english.note: Use 探索 as the all-purpose noun for the process of exploring or investigating, including neutral geographical discovery.
Use this for discovery understood as an intentional process of exploring or seeking out new things, especially on a voyage or in research.

examples.english: Our exploration this time is mainly about studying this cave.
examples.traditional: 我哋今次嘅探索，主要係研究呢個山洞。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 ge3 taam3 sok3 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 jin4 gau3 ni1 go3 saan1 dung6

examples.english: This space exploration led to a major discovery.
examples.traditional: 呢次太空探索令科學家有重大發現。
examples.jyutping: ni1 ci3 taai3 hung1 taam3 sok3 ling6 fo1 hok6 gaa1 jau5 zung6 daai6 faat3 jin6
